title: A range ending in `-1` means 'to the last element', not 'to nothing'
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: This is why the first element needs an explicit `if (idx == 0) []` instead of trusting `payload[0 to idx - 1]` to come out empty on its own — at `idx = 0` that range is `[0 to -1]`, which is the whole array, not an empty one.
